## 8D. Preferred Role-Based Fonts ✒️

For authorized typography decisions only, prefer these defaults, **never require them**:
- UI controls: prefer Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Bold (NOM-0250).
- reading text: prefer Lexend (NOM-0251).
- technical monospace: prefer Monaspace Krypton Nerd Font Bold (NOM-0252).
- general headings: prefer Luciole Bold (NOM-0253).
- accessibility-critical labels: prefer Lexica Ultralegible (NOM-0254).
- condensed editorial titles: prefer League Gothic (NOM-0255).

The functional role, readability, accessibility, glyph coverage, licensing, installation, language, rendering, layout, established project identity and contextual aesthetic may justify a different font. Do not impose these as a whitelist, invent a redesign task, or change an existing accepted design without authorization.
